original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚塔拉巴州MACBAN主席遭枪手杀害，当地局势紧张
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据SaharaReporters报道，尼日利亚塔拉巴州塔库姆地方政府区Miyetti Allah养牛协会（MACBAN）主席Alhaji Ibrahim Dio于周日晚在其住所遭枪手开枪打死。据称，袭击者骑摩托车抵达其位于Abuja Quarters的住所行凶，事发时他刚从塔库姆牛市返回。塔拉巴州警方发言人尚未就此置评，其电话无法接通。该事件目前为单一来源报道，尚未获得交叉验证。

location.site: Abuja Quarters, along Rogo Primary School Road
location.raw_text: Dio’s residence in Abuja Quarters, along Rogo Primary School Road, Takum, Takum Local Government Area, Taraba State

key_facts.fact: Miyetti Allah养牛协会（MACBAN）塔库姆地方政府区主席Alhaji Ibrahim Dio遭枪手开枪打死
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Gunmen have shot dead Alhaji Ibrahim Dio, Chairman of the Miyetti Allah Cattle Breeders Association (MACBAN) in the Takum Local Government Area of Taraba State.

key_facts.fact: 事件发生在周日晚，袭击者闯入其位于塔库姆Abuja Quarters的住所行凶
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the incident occurred on Sunday evening when the assailants stormed Dio’s residence in Abuja Quarters, along Rogo Primary School Road, Takum, and shot him dead.

key_facts.fact: 据称袭击者骑摩托车抵达，事发时死者刚从塔库姆牛市返回
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the deceased had returned home safely from the Takum Cattle Market on Sunday evening before the gunmen, who reportedly arrived on a motorcycle, attacked his residence and opened fire on him.

key_facts.fact: 死者葬礼祈祷于周一上午8时左右在其住所附近举行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: the funeral prayer for the deceased was held on Monday at about 8am in Abuja Quarters, along Rogo Primary School Road, Takum.

key_facts.fact: 塔拉巴州警方发言人未就事件置评，电话无法接通
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Efforts by SaharaReporters to contact the Taraba State Police Command spokesperson, Victor Mshelizah, for comments on the incident were unsuccessful, as his phone line was unreachable.

uncertainties: 事件目前仅由SaharaReporters单一来源报道，尚未获得交叉验证
袭击者身份与作案动机尚未确认
警方尚未就事件作出回应或确认
